title: ARC-AGI-3 causal reasoning trace
entry_trigger: User requested a new target that would be externally impressive to trace after pinning GEMS.
preferred_referent: 📍 ARC3-TRACE-001 — trace one public ARC-AGI-3 environment from raw observation through causal model, inferred goal, plan, action, correction, and replay evidence.
goal: Produce a provenance-preserving causal trace for one public ARC-AGI-3 environment that separates observation, intervention, observed effect, hypothesis, falsification/correction, inferred rule, inferred goal, plan, and verified outcome. Then test whether the same trace contract can be reused on a second environment.
definition_of_solved_for_first_trace: Every admitted rule is tied to an observable state transition or replay witness.
Failed hypotheses remain preserved rather than silently rewritten.
The inferred goal is distinguished from the mechanics used to reach it.
A compact world model predicts at least one later state transition before it is observed.
The final trace explains a successful or meaningfully advancing action sequence without relying on hidden instructions.
The output can be presented unchanged as input to the same trace contract on another public environment.

benchmark_context.name: ARC-AGI-3
benchmark_context.external_witness: Hidden benchmark evaluation plus public replay/action traces and human baselines.
benchmark_context.prize_relation: $850K ARC-AGI-3 track; $700K grand prize for 100% according to official competition page.
benchmark_context.important_boundary: Prize-eligible competition solutions must be open source and evaluation has no internet access. The first trace is public research and does not claim competition eligibility or benchmark performance.

initial_target.reason: It is a public ARC-AGI-3 demo environment with inspectable model replays showing exploratory actions, mistaken hypotheses, corrections, and partial progression. This makes the reasoning path externally inspectable rather than invented from a solved description.

next_movement: Reconstruct ar25 from the earliest observable transitions first: make a state/action/effect ledger before accepting any semantic interpretation. Use later replay reasoning only as comparison evidence, not as ground truth.

handoff_from.reason: Explicit user-directed referent change. GEMS remains pinned and resumable.
